svg.title: ScaleFlow — Chen-Style Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Current EF Core schema after removal of custom UserRole, Permission, RolePermission and TaskProgressSnapshot. All 26 application entities and standard Identity role membership are shown with selected attributes and 51 foreign-key links. Context references repeat existing tables, not new entities.

g.text: Current schema • 26 application entities + standard Identity role join • selected attributes • 18 Sep 2026
All application foreign keys are shown. Schema presence does not imply that every feature or API is implemented.

g.text: (1,1) = exactly one • (0,1) = optional, at most one • (0,N) = zero or many • ? = nullable attribute
Each relationship leg shows how many instances a row of its connected entity may participate in.
49 application FK links + 2 standard Identity role links. Unshown Identity claims/login/token support tables remain in the database.
All mapped FKs use Restrict. Inherited audit/soft-delete attributes are selectively omitted; polymorphic IDs without FKs are not drawn as relationships.
